name: onshore-air-site-tools
description: Generator and QA helpers for the Onshore Air website. Logo: cd logo && npm install && node build-logo.js. Everything else uses system Node, Playwright and ImageMagick.

scripts.logo: cd logo && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && node build-logo.js
scripts.release: node build.js && node check.js && node screenshots.js && bash zip.sh
